Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Velvet Stripe Throw Pillow - 18 x 18 Inch, Grey
Colors: Grey
Imported Simple, white, angular embroidery stripes affix a luxurious, soft gray velvet applique to form the gorgeous face of this modern throw pillow. With its clean lies and eye-catching pattern, it’s sure to make a statement. 18"L x 18"W Velvet applique and embroidery; hidden zipper closure Pillow cover and insert Spot clean only.
